tagline: Convert cURL commands to production-ready axios code with async/await and proper error handling
pageDescription: Free cURL to axios converter generates JavaScript and TypeScript code using the popular axios HTTP client. Emits a full AxiosRequestConfig with method, url, headers, params, data, auth, and timeout fields. Wraps requests in async/await with try/catch and axios.isAxiosError narrowing so you can paste directly into Node.js services, Next.js API routes, or React components. Browser-based conversion keeps your cURL command private — no server roundtrip, no signup.

troubleshooting: Module not found: run 'npm install axios' in your project
CORS error in browser: configure server CORS, not axios
timeout exceeded: increase timeout or profile slow upstream
Body not sent: verify -d or --data flags present in source cURL
TypeScript errors: install @types for target HTTP types if needed
